name: Tehran
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: -15 to > -20 basin average; -25 to -36 peak in SW Tehran/Shahriar/Varamin
literature_sources: Haghighi & Motagh (2019), Remote Sensing of Environment
agreement_note: Headline -3.5 cm LOS (-4.7 cm vert est.) understates literature 4-6x because primary reference (51.200E, 35.545N) sits inside the Shahriar SW subsidence cone. Re-referencing to alt_reference (51.489E, 35.702N) yields -7.3 cm LOS (-9.7 cm vert est. over 120 d, ~-29.6 cm/yr vert est.), matching literature (ratio 1.09).
press_summary_gate_note: Exclude -3.5 cm from press summary until PC10 re-runs with off-basin northern Alborz/bedrock reference.

first_nisar_measurement.evidence: No peer-reviewed NISAR Tehran subsidence paper found as of 2026-11-14.
first_nisar_measurement.atlas_first_claim_note: Multi-basin standardized atlas phrasing must use qualified (to our knowledge) only after excluding Mexico City from any individual-first claim.

quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
